title: Microwaved Instant Noodle Bowl with Onion, Garlic and Herbs

steps.do: Peel {garlic_cloves} of garlic over the trash
steps.done_when: papery skin separated from the white garlic clove and clove is fully exposed

steps.do: Open {instant_noodle_packet} of instant noodles and remove the noodle block
steps.done_when: dry noodle block sits outside its packaging on the counter

steps.do: Retrieve the cutting board and knife
steps.done_when: cutting board and knife are on the counter ready for chopping

steps.do: Finely chop the peeled garlic on the cutting board
steps.done_when: garlic is cut into small minced pieces scattered on the cutting board

steps.do: Peel {red_onion} red onion over the trash
steps.done_when: papery outer skin removed and onion bulb is exposed

steps.do: Slice the peeled red onion into thin pieces on the cutting board
steps.done_when: onion is cut into thin rings and small pieces spread on the cutting board

steps.do: Transfer the chopped garlic and sliced onion into the bowl
steps.done_when: bowl contains the chopped garlic and separated onion slices and cutting board is mostly empty

steps.do: Crumble {instant_noodle_packet} of dry noodles into the bowl with the onion and garlic
steps.done_when: dry noodle block is broken into small crumbled pieces mixed with onion in the bowl

steps.do: Add {water} to the bowl to cover and soak the noodles
steps.done_when: bowl is filled with water and noodles are submerged and wet

steps.do: Place the bowl in the microwave and cover it with a plate
steps.done_when: bowl sits inside the microwave covered by a plate with the door ready to close

steps.do: Heat the bowl in the microwave for {microwave_time}
steps.done_when: microwave display shows {microwave_time} and is running with the door closed

steps.do: Remove the bowl and plate from the microwave to the counter
steps.done_when: bowl of heated noodles sits uncovered on the counter and microwave is open and empty

steps.do: Sprinkle seasoning over the noodles in the bowl
steps.done_when: dry seasoning powder is visible scattered over the noodles in the bowl

steps.do: Chop {cilantro_sprigs} of cilantro on the cutting board
steps.done_when: herbs are cut into small green pieces piled on the cutting board

steps.do: Add the chopped herbs and the contents of the seasoning packet to the noodle bowl
steps.done_when: green chopped herbs and seasoning granules rest on top of the noodles in the bowl

steps.do: Stir the noodles, seasoning, and herbs together with a fork
steps.done_when: noodles, broth, seasoning and herbs are evenly mixed in the bowl with fork resting inside
